outer_assignment.scope: Summed assignment event spans and node wall; concurrent nodes overlap. Separate from legacy GKR launch/device_ms counters; not GPU occupancy.

gpu.launch_count_scope: Source-derived GKR traversal only, not CUPTI; excludes other stages
gpu.device_time_scope: Summed GKR/composition CUDA-event spans and PCS resident time; includes enqueue gaps; excludes untimed stages and overlaps
gpu.memory_scope: Native logical counters; physical device peak is sampled separately

physical_gpu_memory_peak.scope: Sampled whole-device usage, includes driver and unrelated processes; target interval 200ms, not exact process peak
physical_gpu_memory_peak.kernel_activity_scope: NVML sampled kernel-active percentage; arithmetic sample mean, not time-weighted, not SM occupancy or process-exclusive utilization
